 Advertisement Home › Music › News ROCKY To Return To Manila For ‘Fake It’ Fan Concert This December
 The former ASTRO member will be returning to Manila following the release of his latest EP, UNSAID .
 By Joseph Verallo 
 41 seconds ago Courtesy of @wonijin_official
 Courtesy of @wonijin_official
 Korean rapper- singer-songwriter Singer-Songwriter A musician who writes and performs their own songs, typically accompanied by guitar or piano. Valued for personal storytelling and authenticity, singer-songwriters form a major part of the Filipino music Go to Singer-Songwriter Glossary ROCKY is coming back to Manila, with a fan concert happening at the Samsung Hall in SM Aura on December 20, 2026, at 7:00 PM.
 Dubbed ‘ Fake It ‘ after the third track of his latest EP EP Short for extended play, a collection of songs longer than a single but shorter than a full album, typically containing three to six tracks. Artists use EPs to introduce their Go to EP Glossary UNSAID , the concert will see the K-pop star’s return to the Philippines following his ‘Fill In The Blank’ Fan Concert at the SM Skydome in August 2025.
 Although known for his role in the K-pop K-Pop A genre of South Korean popular music known for polished production, intricate choreography, and elaborate visuals, built around trainee systems and global fandoms. K-pop has a huge following in the Go to K-Pop Glossary boy band ASTRO , formed in 2016 under Fantagio, the singer made his official solo debut in 2023 following his departure from the group and the expiration of his contract with Fantagio. The same year, the artist launched his own agency, WONJIN Entertainment , under which he released his debut EP, ROCKYST .
 ROCKY’s upcoming Manila fan concert will be presented by CDM Entertainment , with ticket prices to be announced by the event promoter. According to the official concert poster, tickets will be available through Ticketmaster .
 For future updates, follow CDM Entertainment on social media. Alternatively, you can follow the artist’s agency, WONIJIN Entertainment, for updates on the artist and his shows.
 While waiting for ROCKY’s return to Manila, listen to his latest EP EP Short for extended play, a collection of songs longer than a single but shorter than a full album, typically containing three to six tracks. Artists use EPs to introduce their Go to EP Glossary , UNSAID , below:
 Frequently Asked Questions
 When and where is ROCKY’s Manila fan concert?
 ROCKY’s ‘Fake It’ fan concert is set for December 20, 2026, at 7:00 PM at Samsung Hall in SM Aura.
 Why is ROCKY’s Manila fan concert called ‘Fake It’?
 The concert is named after the third track of ROCKY’s latest EP, UNSAID, and marks his return to the Philippines.
 When did ROCKY last perform in Manila?
 ROCKY’s previous Manila show was the ‘Fill In The Blank’ fan concert, held at the SM Skydome in August 2025.
 Who is presenting ROCKY’s Manila concert, and where can tickets be bought?
 CDM Entertainment presents the concert; prices are yet to be announced, with tickets available through Ticketmaster per the official poster.
 Who is ROCKY?
 ROCKY is a Korean rapper-singer-songwriter and former ASTRO member who debuted solo in 2023 under his own agency, WONJIN Entertainment.
